source_snapshot.procedure: In BMC Web, click `SOL console` and verify access to the Serial over LAN console.
source_snapshot.criteria: The icon link should be workable.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL expands the link check into sending/reading serial data and keystroke echo, adding host-console impact not authorized by the source.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION adds channel/mapping/session/recovery controls but likewise broadens the row into an interactive echo/readback test.

old_problem: The historical record restored the source-faithful link boundary but retained Pending for build-specific route/readiness, role, auto-connect behavior, SOL session ownership and cleanup.
disposition_reason: The source asks only whether the WebUI icon reaches the SOL console. Route/page identity and terminal-component initialization can be tested without injecting serial input. If the vendor UI auto-connects, passive output and clean disconnect are bounded consequences, not permission for echo or host interaction. Build, role, auto-connect/session-slot behavior and cleanup are execution inputs. ED-08 requires real browser evidence, ED-20 preserves link-only coverage, ED-35 prevents broader interactive testing from replacing it, and ED-38 gates session acquisition and recovery.
decision_basis: XLSX row 852, same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2 and historical record were directly reviewed.

Web link/navigation coverage checks gesture, authorization, route and terminal initialization; full SOL transport coverage additionally needs channel mapping, serial parameters, safe stimulus and host recovery and belongs in a separate approved case.
A click may automatically consume a scarce SOL session slot, so ownership and clean termination remain required even though no input is sent.
The Review-layer case explicitly records transmit/receive/echo/host-input as outside this row rather than falsely claiming it.

test_case.test_name: Verify the BMC Web SOL console link and passive terminal initialization without serial input
test_case.purpose: Prove the approved role's `SOL console` WebUI control routes once to the intended Serial over LAN page and initializes the documented terminal ready/error state; if selection automatically connects, passively correlate and then cleanly release the intended session without sending any keystroke, command, break or credential.
required_package: Exact BMC endpoint/certificate/controller, firmware and WebUI build
Approved account role and expected visibility/authorization for the SOL console link
Stable SOL link selector, expected route/page heading, terminal component identity and documented ready/error state
Vendor definition of click-only versus automatic session allocation/connection behavior
Current SOL session/owner/slot status, approved session window/timeout and supported disconnect/close sequence
Alternate KVM/OOB recovery, protected browser credentials/session and console-output redaction rules
test_case.test_command: Bind the isolated browser to the exact BMC/build/role, record current route and read active SOL session/owner/slot state through the approved non-mutating path. Confirm from versioned documentation whether clicking auto-connects and obtain approval if it consumes a slot. Locate the exact SOL console link by semantic attributes and click once. Capture the gesture, route/page heading, terminal component load and documented ready/error state. If auto-connected, observe only enough passive output to correlate the intended session, redact sensitive data, record start/end state and disconnect using the supported control. Verify no orphan session remains and alternate access is healthy. Send no key, command, newline, break, boot input or login data; do not clear logs or retry automatically.
test_case.expected_result: The correct SOL link is visible/authorized, one activation reaches the approved Serial over LAN route/page and the terminal component reaches its documented ready state without navigation/application error. If auto-connect is expected, it binds the intended session, exposes only passively observed output and closes cleanly with the slot released. No input/configuration is sent, no existing owner is preempted and BMC/host/OOB access remains healthy.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires identity-bound browser evidence of the exact link, one gesture, correct route/page/component-ready result, approved auto-connect behavior, passive-only session correlation where applicable and clean slot release, with engineer verdict. A generic terminal window, route alone without component state, echoed key, interactive prompt or ipmitool session cannot substitute. Wrong route/channel/session, permission error, component failure, owner preemption, orphaned slot, unexpected input or failed disconnect is FAIL. Missing role/route/auto-connect/ownership/cleanup inputs is NOT READY, not Pending or PASS.
safety_gate: Do not send serial keystrokes, commands, newlines, break sequences, boot-menu input or login credentials; they are outside this source row.
Before clicking, determine whether the link auto-connects and consumes/preempts a SOL slot; verify ownership and obtain explicit approval when it does.
Bind endpoint, BMC identity, role and route; never accept another system's console or a generic terminal as evidence.
If passive output appears, minimize and redact transcript content, secrets and privileged boot data.
Do not clear BMC/SEL/host/console logs; preserve session/audit events.
Click once only. On popup block, error, timeout, wrong session or unexpected allocation, stop and cleanly terminate if safe; no automatic retry.
expected_evidence: BMC/controller/certificate, firmware/WebUI build and authenticated role identity
Pre-click active SOL session/owner/slot state and versioned click-only/auto-connect behavior
Redacted DOM/screenshot of exact SOL link plus single-click route/page heading and terminal ready/error state
If auto-connected: target/session correlation, minimal passive output, start/end audit and supported clean disconnect
Proof no keystroke/command/configuration was sent, no slot remains allocated and BMC/host/alternate OOB access is healthy
Explicit exclusion of transmit/receive/echo/host-input coverage and authorized engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On wrong console, owner conflict or unexpected session allocation, send no input, stop capture and terminate only through the supported disconnect path if safe. Use the approved KVM/OOB route to verify host state and restore console ownership, preserve session/audit evidence and escalate any lost access. Do not retry or inject input to identify the console.

source_conflict.reason: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently define a WebUI SOL icon/link access check; interactive echo was prior-review scope expansion, not Master conflict.

blocked.reason: The control and navigation outcome are clear; UI route/readiness, role, auto-connect and session ownership/cleanup are supplyable inputs.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: BMC/UI build, account role, SOL selector/route/component state, click-only versus auto-connect behavior, slot ownership, timeout/disconnect, redaction and alternate recovery.

project_authority: Version-matched vendor BMC WebUI SOL navigation/session documentation and Project console-ownership policy define readiness, auto-connect and clean disconnect; interactive SOL function is separate coverage.
